title: 接触角/润湿边界 LBM 实现方法参考手册
scope: Compiled contact-angle implementation notes from three LBM textbooks, covering Shan-Chen, free-energy, color-gradient, and phase-field wetting boundary conditions.
project_use: Separate phase-field wetting formulas from pseudo-potential virtual-density formulas.
Use surface-free-energy or geometric virtual-order-parameter boundary conditions as the Stage18 phase-field wetting route.
Audit near-wall gradient/Laplace and h_i population boundary placement before interpreting static contact angles.
Treat dynamic advancing/receding contact angle as not specified by the books and requiring separate literature/validation.
limits: Do not copy the full manual text into the repository.
Do not transplant Shan-Chen wall-density or color-gradient virtual-density formulas directly into the conservative Allen-Cahn phase-field solver.
The manual provides implementation directions and textbook formulas, not validation evidence for the current code.
